stories.title: Tenstorrent raises $1.5 billion, valuation climbs to $6.2 billion
stories.summary: Tenstorrent, a chip startup focused on inference, raised $1.5 billion in a financing round that valued the company at $6.2 billion, more than double its $2.6 billion valuation in late 2024. The round was led by Trace Capital and Innovation X, with participation from Cadence Ventures, Eclipse, Fidelity, SanDisk and T. Rowe Price. Proceeds will be used to scale chips for open‑weight AI models and video generation.
stories.why: The funding strengthens competition in AI hardware and supports alternatives to Nvidia’s dominant GPUs.

stories.title: RBI tightens scrutiny of large overseas direct investments
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has introduced stricter oversight of large overseas direct investments by Indian companies. Banks are now required to collect and submit detailed information on such investments to the RBI and to carry out thorough due‑diligence on the investment rationale. The measure is intended to help prevent potential losses for the companies and for the Indian economy.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: Rubio says India‑US trade deal is “very, very close” after Jaishankar meeting
stories.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said negotiations for a trade deal with India are approaching completion. He referenced recent talks with Indian Foreign Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar on energy security and defence cooperation. Rubio’s visit to India also included a tour of the Reliance Industries refinery and meetings with business leaders, while tariff and energy tensions persist.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
